core_meaning.primary_meaning: Abduh is an Arabic-origin name meaning “His servant”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Abduh represents Arabic عبده (ʿabduhu), commonly interpreted as “his servant” from عبد (“servant”) plus the attached pronoun ـه (“his”). The name is associated with the Egyptian reformer Muḥammad ʿAbduh. The form does not explicitly contain الله (“God”), so “servant of God” is not the literal translation.

etymology.etymology_explanation: The form عبده can be parsed as عبد plus the attached pronoun ـه. In name usage, the possessive reference may depend on context; this record uses the literal grammatical reading “his servant.”

faq.a: The record classifies Abduh as masculine, consistent with the historical bearer; regional usage can vary.
